prompt_used: You are given an image. Write a detailed natural language prompt that could have been used to generate this image. Focus on the most salient and unique visual elements such as the subjects, their clothing, expressions, actions, background, and composition. Describe the color palette, lighting, and overall style, including any cinematic or artistic qualities like camera angle, depth of field, or motion. Make the description as accurate and faithful to the image as possible. If small details are uncertain or ambiguous, omit them and prioritize capturing the overall scene, mood, and visual impression. The final prompt should be coherent, evocative, written as if by an expert visual artist or filmmaker recreating the exact scene.
caption: A minimalist, contemporary scene set against a solid, pastel yellow background. In the center foreground sits a black wire mesh wastebasket filled with loosely crumpled white paper, its geometric lines creating a striking contrast with the soft backdrop. Emerging from the top of the frame, a single human arm, dressed in a light mint-green, long-sleeved shirt, reaches down into the basket, hand partially submerged among the papers, suggesting an action of either discarding or retrieving something. The composition is clean and uncluttered, with a strong sense of order and symmetry. In the upper right corner, a simple white wall clock with black hands and numerals is partially visible, adding a subtle element of time and routine. The lighting is bright and even, casting soft shadows and enhancing the crispness of the scene. The overall style is modern and graphic, with a playful yet purposeful mood, reminiscent of conceptual commercial photography or editorial illustration. The camera angle is straight-on at eye level, with a shallow depth of field that keeps all elements in sharp focus, emphasizing clarity and intention.
